verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents a general payments API and automated fraud and chargeback protection. Nothing in it describes dispute endpoints for retrieving disputes, uploading evidence, or submitting a dispute response through the API. Fraud prevention is an adjacent feature and does not count as agent-driven dispute handling.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent handle a dispute end-to-end, retrieving it, assembling evidence, and submitting the response via the API
